explicate.en: The authors explicate the mechanism that links job insecurity to lower well-being.
explicate.zh: 作者阐明了工作不安全感与幸福感下降之间的作用机制。

explicate.en: Several concepts in the draft need to be explicated before the review panel meets.
explicate.zh: 评审组开会前，草稿中的几个概念需要进一步阐明。

explicate.en: Her lecture explicated why the two constructs are often confused in the literature.
explicate.zh: 她的讲座解释了为什么文献中常把这两个构念混为一谈。

enumerate.en: The study enumerates five distinct barriers to the uptake of remote learning.
enumerate.zh: 该研究列举了远程学习推广所面临的五项不同障碍。

enumerate.en: Reviewers are asked to enumerate the methodological limitations of each design.
enumerate.zh: 评审人被要求逐一列出每种研究设计的方法学局限。

enumerate.en: The appendix enumerates all cases that were excluded after data cleaning.
enumerate.zh: 附录逐一列出了数据清理后被排除的全部案例。

discern.en: It is difficult to discern a genuine effect from sampling noise in a single study.
discern.zh: 在单项研究中很难从抽样噪声中分辨出真正的效应。

discern.en: From the interview transcripts we discern a clear shift in participants' language.
discern.zh: 从访谈记录中，我们分辨出参与者用语的明显转变。

discern.en: The pattern is visible in the raw data but hard to discern in the aggregated figures.
discern.zh: 这一模式在原始数据中可见，但在汇总数据中难以分辨。

elicit.en: Follow-up interviews were used to elicit explanations for the inconsistent results.
elicit.zh: 研究者利用后续访谈来引出对不一致结果的解释。

elicit.en: Careful wording is needed to elicit honest answers about sensitive topics.
elicit.zh: 在敏感话题上需要谨慎的措辞才能引出诚实的回答。

elicit.en: The survey design was revised to elicit responses from non-native speakers.
elicit.zh: 调查设计经过修订，以引出非母语者的回答。

illuminate.en: These data illuminate the conditions under which the intervention actually works.
illuminate.zh: 这些数据阐明了该干预真正发挥作用的条件。

illuminate.en: A single well-designed case can illuminate a pattern that surveys tend to obscure.
illuminate.zh: 一个精心设计的案例就能阐明调查往往掩盖的模式。

illuminate.en: The discussion illuminates how theory and practice diverge in everyday settings.
illuminate.zh: 讨论阐明了理论与实践在日常情境中如何产生偏离。

preclude.en: The small sample size precludes any firm conclusion about the population.
preclude.zh: 样本量过小使人无法对总体情况得出确定结论。

preclude.en: Its wording precludes the possibility of a neutral reading of the contract.
preclude.zh: 这一措辞排除了对合同作中立解读的可能。

preclude.en: Funding rules preclude the two teams from sharing raw participant data.
preclude.zh: 资助规定不允许两个团队共享参与者的原始数据。

surmount.en: The intervention was redesigned so that participants could surmount the technical barriers.
surmount.zh: 该干预经过重新设计，使参与者能够克服技术障碍。

surmount.en: Small grants often help early-career researchers surmount the barrier of data access costs.
surmount.zh: 小额资助常常帮助职业早期研究者克服获取数据的费用障碍。

surmount.en: The chapter explains how local institutions surmounted political resistance to reform.
surmount.zh: 该章解释了地方机构如何克服了对改革的政治阻力。

undertake.en: The team agrees to undertake a systematic review of forty years of published evidence.
undertake.zh: 该团队同意对 40 年间已发表的证据开展一项系统综述。

undertake.en: Participants undertake a short battery of cognitive tasks each morning.
undertake.zh: 参与者每天早晨完成一组简短的认知任务。

undertake.en: Any researcher undertaking this protocol must complete the ethics training first.
undertake.zh: 任何开展该研究方案的研究者都必须先完成伦理培训。

necessitate.en: The scale of the problem necessitates a coordinated response across departments.
necessitate.zh: 问题的规模使各部门协同应对成为必要。

necessitate.en: Such claims would necessitate far more evidence than the study provides.
necessitate.zh: 这样的主张所需的证据远超本研究所提供的范围。

necessitate.en: Growing demand has necessitated a revision of the eligibility criteria.
necessitate.zh: 需求增长使资格标准不得不作出修订。

alleviate.en: Targeted subsidies can alleviate the financial burden on low-income households.
alleviate.zh: 有针对性的补贴可以减轻低收入家庭的经济负担。

alleviate.en: The guidance was revised to alleviate confusion among first-time applicants.
alleviate.zh: 指南经过修订，以减轻初次申请者的困惑。

alleviate.en: Short breaks during long interviews helped alleviate fatigue among participants.
alleviate.zh: 长时间访谈中的短暂休息有助于缓解参与者的疲劳。

deviate.en: These results deviate sharply from what the mainstream model predicts.
deviate.zh: 这些结果与主流模型的预测存在明显偏离。

deviate.en: Where the coding scheme deviates from the original protocol, we note the change explicitly.
deviate.zh: 凡编码方案偏离原研究方案之处，我们都明确标注。

deviate.en: Schools that deviate from the national curriculum still have to meet minimum standards.
deviate.zh: 偏离国家课程的学校仍须达到最低标准。

consolidate.en: A larger replication would consolidate the evidence for this effect.
consolidate.zh: 更大规模的复现研究将巩固这一效应的证据基础。

consolidate.en: The two-year program consolidates scattered local initiatives into a single framework.
consolidate.zh: 这个为期两年的项目把分散的地方举措整合到一个统一框架之中。

consolidate.en: The final chapter consolidates the findings of the four empirical chapters.
consolidate.zh: 最后一章整合了四个实证章节的发现。

conceptualization.en: The conceptualization of resilience differs sharply across the four case studies.
conceptualization.zh: 对韧性的概念化在四个案例研究中差异显著。

conceptualization.en: A clearer conceptualization is needed before the scale can be validated.
conceptualization.zh: 在量表得到验证之前，需要更清晰的概念化。

conceptualization.en: Her conceptualization of trust draws on both economics and sociology.
conceptualization.zh: 她对信任的概念化同时借鉴了经济学与社会学。

quantification.en: The quantification of uncertainty remains the weakest part of the analysis.
quantification.zh: 对不确定性的量化仍然是该分析中最薄弱的部分。

quantification.en: Careful quantification of the costs is essential for a credible policy recommendation.
quantification.zh: 对成本进行审慎量化，是提出可信政策建议的前提。

quantification.en: The paper offers a defensible method of quantification for qualitative data.
quantification.zh: 本文提出了一种对定性数据进行量化的可靠方法。

preregistration.en: Preregistration of hypotheses helps to separate genuine findings from noise.
preregistration.zh: 对假设进行预注册有助于把真正的发现与噪声区分开来。

preregistration.en: Since 2020 the journal has required preregistration for all confirmatory studies.
preregistration.zh: 自 2020 年起，该期刊要求所有验证性研究都必须进行预注册。

preregistration.en: The authors posted their preregistration before collecting any data.
preregistration.zh: 作者在收集任何数据之前就公布了他们的预注册方案。

disclosure.en: Full disclosure of conflicts of interest is required by the journal.
disclosure.zh: 期刊要求充分披露利益冲突。

disclosure.en: The disclosure of raw data allows other teams to check the arithmetic.
disclosure.zh: 原始数据的公开让其他团队得以核查计算过程。

disclosure.en: Non-disclosure of adverse events remains a serious methodological problem.
disclosure.zh: 不披露不良事件仍是一个严重的方法学问题。

confidentiality.en: The confidentiality of participant data is protected by an anonymous coding scheme.
confidentiality.zh: 参与者数据的保密性由匿名编码方案加以保护。

confidentiality.en: Breaches of confidentiality are reported to the ethics board within 48 hours.
confidentiality.zh: 违反保密规定的情况须在 48 小时内报告伦理委员会。

confidentiality.en: Reviewers must sign a confidentiality agreement before reading the draft manuscript.
confidentiality.zh: 评审人在阅读草稿手稿前必须签署保密协议。

plagiarism.en: The journal screens every submission with dedicated plagiarism detection software.
plagiarism.zh: 该期刊用专门的查重软件筛查每一篇投稿。

plagiarism.en: Careful citation is the surest defense against accidental plagiarism.
plagiarism.zh: 谨慎引用是防止无意识抄袭最可靠的保障。

plagiarism.en: Instances of plagiarism lead to retraction of the affected article.
plagiarism.zh: 抄袭行为会导致相关论文被撤稿。

register.en: The register of the paper shifts noticeably between the introduction and the conclusion.
register.zh: 该论文的语域在引言与结论之间发生了明显变化。

register.en: Students learn to adjust their register when writing for a specialist audience.
register.zh: 学生学习在面向专业读者写作时调整自己的语域。

register.en: A formal register is expected in the methods section of the report.
register.zh: 报告的方法部分要求使用正式的语体。

genre.en: Each academic genre imposes its own conventions on length and structure.
genre.zh: 每一种学术体裁对篇幅与结构都有各自的惯例要求。

genre.en: The article borrows conventions from the research proposal genre.
genre.zh: 这篇文章借用了研究计划书这一体裁的惯例。

genre.en: Genre differences partly explain why the two reviews differ in emphasis.
genre.zh: 体裁差异在一定程度上解释了两篇综述在侧重点上的不同。

counterargument.en: The authors address the most plausible counterargument in their final section.
counterargument.zh: 作者在最后一节回应了最有可能成立的反驳意见。

counterargument.en: A strong counterargument can strengthen a paper rather than weaken it.
counterargument.zh: 有力的反驳意见反而能让论文更扎实。

counterargument.en: Any serious proposal must anticipate the standard counterargument about cost.
counterargument.zh: 任何严肃的方案都必须预见到关于成本的标准反驳。

cohesion.en: Clear signposting improves cohesion in long argumentative texts.
cohesion.zh: 清晰的篇章过渡提示能提升长篇论证文本的连贯性。

cohesion.en: The report suffers from weak cohesion between the literature review and the methods.
cohesion.zh: 该报告在文献综述与方法部分之间连贯性薄弱。

cohesion.en: Cohesion depends on the reader's ability to infer the underlying argument.
cohesion.zh: 连贯性取决于读者推断隐含论点的能力。

wording.en: The wording of the consent form was revised to be more accessible.
wording.zh: 知情同意书的措辞经过修订，变得更易理解。

wording.en: A few changes in wording can shift the tone of the whole argument.
wording.zh: 措辞上的少许改动就能改变整个论点的语气。

wording.en: Reviewers should comment on the wording, not only on the substance of the text.
wording.zh: 评审人应当对措辞提出意见，而不仅仅针对文本内容。

triangulation.en: Methodological triangulation was used to check the reliability of the findings.
triangulation.zh: 研究者采用方法学三角互证来检验结果的可靠性。

triangulation.en: Triangulation of interviews and diaries reduces the risk of a single-source bias.
triangulation.zh: 访谈与日记的三角互证降低了单一来源偏差的风险。

triangulation.en: The chapter discusses when triangulation strengthens a qualitative design.
triangulation.zh: 该章讨论了三角互证在何种情况下能增强定性研究设计。

conceptual.en: The conceptual framework links resource-based and dynamic capabilities.
conceptual.zh: 该概念框架把资源基础观与动态能力观联系起来。

conceptual.en: A purely conceptual contribution still requires empirical support in this field.
conceptual.zh: 在本领域，纯粹的概念性贡献仍需要经验证据支持。

conceptual.en: The paper moves from a conceptual model to a set of testable propositions.
conceptual.zh: 该论文从概念模型推进到一组可检验的命题。

multidisciplinary.en: The team is deliberately multidisciplinary, combining economics, sociology and statistics.
multidisciplinary.zh: 该团队刻意采用多学科构成，融合了经济学、社会学与统计学。

multidisciplinary.en: Multidisciplinary collaboration raises the cost but also the impact of the work.
multidisciplinary.zh: 多学科合作提高了成本，但也提升了研究的影响力。

multidisciplinary.en: A multidisciplinary clinic was established to treat the condition holistically.
multidisciplinary.zh: 一家多学科诊所成立，以整体方式治疗该病症。

thematic.en: A thematic analysis of the interviews identified three recurring concerns.
thematic.zh: 对访谈的主题分析识别出三个反复出现的关注点。

thematic.en: The thematic structure of the corpus changed after the second wave of data collection.
thematic.zh: 第二轮数据收集之后，语料库的主题结构发生了变化。

thematic.en: Thematic coding was done by two researchers independently.
thematic.zh: 主题编码由两名研究者独立完成。

rhetorical.en: The rhetorical strategy of the article is to concede the weakest objection early.
rhetorical.zh: 该文的修辞策略是尽早承认最薄弱的反对意见。

rhetorical.en: Rhetorical choices such as repetition shape how readers remember an argument.
rhetorical.zh: 重复等修辞选择会影响读者如何记住一段论证。

rhetorical.en: The review distinguishes between a rhetorical claim and an empirical one.
rhetorical.zh: 该综述区分了修辞性主张与经验性主张。

exploratory.en: An exploratory study identified which factors are worth testing in a larger sample.
exploratory.zh: 一项探索性研究确定了哪些因素值得在更大样本中检验。

exploratory.en: Because the design is exploratory, no confirmatory claims are made.
exploratory.zh: 由于该设计属于探索性质，研究未提出任何验证性主张。

exploratory.en: Exploratory interviews helped refine the wording of the main survey.
exploratory.zh: 探索性访谈帮助细化了主问卷的措辞。

influential.en: Peer review remains the most influential check on the quality of published work.
influential.zh: 同行评审仍是对已发表研究质量最具影响力的把关机制。

influential.en: The most influential factor was the time available to the participants.
influential.zh: 最具影响力的因素是参与者可支配的时间。

influential.en: This paper has been influential in the design of later surveys.
influential.zh: 该论文对后续调查的设计产生了深远影响。
